continuation_strategy.rationale: The generic guarded workflow has successfully completed the preceding production tranches. T000010 contains exactly the 114 remaining B000001 records and, if subsequently reviewed, authorized and executed, will complete scientific screening of positions 1-500.

purpose: Define the final B000001 post-pilot scientific-screening tranche after successful production completion of T000009. T000010 targets all remaining positions 387-500, completing the 500-record B000001 batch while reusing generic guard v2 without modification. This design freezes target identity and operational boundaries only; it contains no scientific decisions and grants no live authority.
